author: Ali Kaviani Far
description: A REST API and web dashboard for managing cron jobs on Linux servers: create, edit, pause, force-run and inspect jobs without editing the crontab by hand.
features: REST API - create, read, update, delete, pause and force-run cron jobs
Dashboard - React interface showing job status, schedules and the last result
Schedule wizard - presets and a custom builder with a plain-language preview and next run time
Force run - execute a job on demand with a timeout and output limit
Execution logs - stdout, stderr, exit code and duration of every forced run
JWT authentication, login rate limiting and a production configuration guard
Self-test - non-destructive health check of the main components

requirements.os: Linux (production); Windows or macOS in mock mode for development
